title: Checker reads record status; refresh the stale rows
goal: The checker fails on a gap citing a closed or archived record, and every current row passes
acceptance: ASI08, LLM06, LLM08 and LLM10 cite the tests F-063, F-064 and F-065 delivered, or an open record for what is still missing
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: read status from the records, re-read four rows. Not a measurement.
